reviews.t: Handy cat brush, easy to remove hair
reviews.x: I actually saw a video of someone brushing a cat on Facebook and the person using it was able to push a button to have a plate extend on the base that raised the hair up so it was easy to remove from the brush. So I looked around on Amazon and found this. Very easy to use and clean and my cats love it! Works great and feels a little heavier than my other brushes, so I believe it's of better quality.

reviews.t: We're thrilled and so are our cats
reviews.x: I saw a similar product advertised on Facebook, so I came to see what was available on Amazon.  I'm glad I chose this one.  First, the wire bristles are very fine and get through to our cats' thick undercoats, reducing hairballs and shedding.  Second, the self-cleaning feature is life-altering.  Every hair comes off in seconds.  (We put it outside for birds to use in nesting materials.)  Third, and best of all, our cats LOVE this brush, so much so that I bought a second one so we could keep one

I have a rough coat collie and am new to the vast amount of hair that comes off this lovely beast.  This brush has the pins that are recommended by groomers to get through the thick hair, but just as importantly, the pins have coated ends to protect the skin. The self-cleaning ability is fabulous because the brush is full after just a couple of swipes down his back. Having to clean the brush so often would damage the pins on a regular pin brush, but with the self-cleaning 'pusher' I'm not bendin

I have a 3 year old Siamese that I adopted that came from a bad situation. He does not like to be brushed at all among other things but he adores this brush. I'm so happy I bought this as it's teaching him to trust myself and my spouse and is helping him to learn that he is safe and loved. Also it does a great job of brushing his short hair and is very easy to clean. Worth a shot if you have a dog/cat that doesn't like to be brushed and/or you need a bridge to help create a trusted bond with you

My cat doesn’t really like being brushed. But he tolerates it. In fact I’m now able to get to all the undercoat as well as his matted areas. I’m very pleased. The photo shows the top half of him after using this brush. Still have more to go but at least he’s letting me do it. 👍🏼😻

reviews.t: Works great but is already breaking
reviews.x: I bought this for my long-haired cat and she LOVES being brushed with it. My cat comes running when she sees me with it and purrs her little heart out while I brush her. With other brushes, she didn’t want me brushing her belly or hips (where, you know, she needs it the most), but with this brush she will roll over on her side and lift her legs up to give me better access. BUT, the prongs are already bending and breaking and I’ve only had it a few weeks. Once the prongs bend, it’s tricky to get

I swear by dog brushes like this (with thin metal tines). They remove the dog hair very easily and the dog seems to enjoy the scratching/massage. I particularly like, on this specific product, the button that is there to push the hair out of the brush. This makes it so easy to clean and reuse over and over while you are brushing your dog, especially if you have a long hair dog like I do and a typical brushing session is going to remove a dozen brush fulls of hair. I highly recommend this product

reviews.t: Loved it in the first 2 minutes!!
reviews.x: This brush JUST came in the mail like 10 minutes ago. Bought it because I’m CONSTANTLY vacuuming and sweeping cat hair. Didn’t realize how much would come off!! It was so satisfying brushing all this hair off of my cat. & he loved it!! It was super easy to clean the hair out with the button in the back & it’s really comfortable to hold! All this hair came out in less than 10 brush strokes! Hopefully I continue to be impressed with this brush!

I have an older cat and her fur is just starting to clump up. As soon as I began to brush her with this brush immediately the clumps began to fall out and her fur started to look and feel so much better. None of the other brushes I've used worked this good nor were they so easy to clean like this one.

This thing is trash for short hair dogs I brushed my dog for 10 minutes. And the brush has any hair in it. My dog rubed my leg and there is more hair on my leg then in the brush I wish I could send this back don't waste youroney or time of you have a short hair dog

reviews.t: Does not remove hair on short hair dog as advertised
reviews.x: Advertized for short hairdos, and selling point of the easy push hair clean out. After 10 minutes brushing onshore hair dog thatched profusely, no hair to clean out
Claims uneasy to break, not true. Combs come out each time and with thick hairy dogs as mine… sadly serves no purpose

reviews.t: Much easier and quicker than a standard brush
reviews.x: This is the way to go. Brush her and then push a button and the hair comes right off the brush afterwards.
My cat did not like it, it was hard to remove the hair, and it makes a weird noise when you brush
Useless for a short hair dog. Might as well use a regular brush. Keep looking.

reviews.t: Works for my black Lab/Border Collie mix
reviews.x: Really nice feel in the hand and the little “fur pucks” we extract from our fuzz bucket come right off the brush head with two or three light button presses. This is easy to use with either hand and while it’s not a wand, it is easier to use than a brush that straps to your hand. In that case, the hand must remain in contact with the coat along with all the body contours. I would argue that with this item’s handle design, you bend over slightly less and you can reach most places by just shifting

reviews.t: The wire brush teeth are tipped with plastic to prevent sensitive skin from harm
reviews.x: Very easy to clean, the button could be a little more quiet. Theres alot of clicking and sliding sounds, springs being worked. But the brush itself does the job it's super durable I love the handle and easy grip, my smaller dog has medium length fur and the brush design really gets down to the undercoat without scraping his skin. My other larger dog however has very short fine hair and loves the brush even though it's not needed. Pet approved, owner approved, 10/10 would recommend

My dogs are both short-haired, but this brush picks that up and holds onto it. With other products, the lightweight hair would just fly into the air, but this makes it fun for both dogs and humans. Cleaning is a breeze: Just hit the button and run underwater if needed. Each bristle has its own hole to push hair through making it efficient to use and clean and is not something I've seen before. I would definitely buy it again!

My shy kitty absolutely loves to be brushed with this! It eclipses all other brushes and combs so far. It’s slightly larger than I imagined it would be for a small cat, but works great. She comes running for a head scratch whenever I pick up the brush. It’s also very easy to remove the hair with the push button. I haven’t been using it for long, and I hope that it won’t break or wear down quickly.

Me and my cat love this brush (especially him). My cat is a huge shedder especially now in the summer. Been trying to find the perfect brush to get really into his second coat and is easy to clean off the brush & I hit the jackpot with this one. I’ve seen a difference in his shedding is getting less. I spend about 10 mins just combing him everyday and I see the hair balls get smaller and smaller.

The first one I ordered was a big hit with my kitties, so I ordered two for my sister who has a dog and a cat that hate to be brushed....until I sent her these brushes.  Now they love being brushed!  She was amazed!  I then ordered another for my other kitty.  Getting ready to order a couple more.  I highly recommend this brush. Your pets with love them as will you!!

reviews.t: I don't recommend for short hair dog
reviews.x: Bought this cause my dog sheds bad.  He's about 24 lbs, short hair,  and loves to be brushed. However this brush almost feels like I'm hurting him.  The bristles are so "sharp" I can't apply much pressure behind the brush in fear of hurting his skin.  It does gather hair and is decent to clean out.  Is probably recommended it for long, really thick furred dogs.

We have 2 dogs and a cat. The cat and chihuahua don’t like this brush, they’re afraid of it. But our Pitsky loves it. He has the undercoat of a Husky. This brush gets the undercoat out very well and he loves to be brushed with it. The only thing I find difficult is holding the button down to clean it. My husband can push the button down much easier than me.

reviews.t: My Younger Cat and I Love This!
reviews.x: I discovered last year that my younger cat loves being brushed/combed.  So, I decided to try this, and she absolutely loves being brushed with this!  She walks around me, purring loudly, while I brush her.  She loves to be brushed on her head and the sides of her neck also.  She and I enjoy our quality time together.  I highly recommend this product!

This brush is just great. I have a medium haired cat that just sheds constantly and also gets mats really easily. This brush does a great job of really clearing out the undercoat and also combing out mats. My cat is really sensitive so she can be a bit reactive to other brushes that tug too much, but she actually enjoys being brushed with this brush.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the self-cleaning button makes removing hair from the brush quick and easy.
Several reviewers report their cats love or tolerate the brush, including finicky or previously reluctant cats.
Multiple reviewers say it effectively removes undercoat, shedding hair, and clumps, especially on thick or double-coated pets.
Several reviewers with short-haired dogs report it removes little to no hair and consider it useless for that coat type.
A few reviewers report durability or handling problems, such as breaking, combs coming out, or difficulty removing hair.
